summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on replacing an obsolete dashboard and developing a new, advanced KPI dashboard for clients. This new system should incorporate natural language queries (NLQ) capabilities, allowing users to interact with the data using AI tools like Claude Pro or Gemini. The underlying data source identified is ClickHouse. The intended users are external clients.

Separately, there were mentions of various business topics including investment models, negotiation strategies (specifically regarding Finland), and time allocation across different company initiatives.
decisions: The new dashboard must support natural language queries for client interaction.
action_items: Determine the scope and timeline for building the AI-enabled KPI dashboard.
